subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these conversation tools, Gateway methods, and durable persisted-delivery contract as the canonical separation between external addresses and local sessions?
rationale: The change introduces a substantial user-facing tool and protocol surface plus compatibility-sensitive persisted state, and the linked issue and protected label explicitly reserve that product direction for maintainers.

options.title: Adopt after full proof
options.body: Keep the proposed architecture, repair the migration gap, require live Reef and upgrade evidence, then review the conflict-free exact head.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Land conversation identity and discovery separately from durable send/turn and persistence behavior to reduce release risk.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the feature issue open and redesign or close this implementation if the new protocol and storage contract are not accepted.

recommendation.title: Adopt after full proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed architecture, repair the migration gap, require live Reef and upgrade evidence, then review the conflict-free exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, who authored the linked product proposal and implementation series.
